title: Vehicle Insight — Selling your car (15s vertical social ad)
background: Bright UK home kitchen, morning light; later a clean driveway handover scene. Realistic, optimistic grade, brand-green accent (#33B87A).

characters.description: British man, late 20s, hoodie, selling his hatchback privately, phone in hand
Couple in their 40s, sceptical at first, warm once convinced

scenes.action: Marketplace messages pile up: 'Is it cat damaged?', 'Any finance on it??', 'Why so cheap lol'. Caption: 'Buyers don't trust sellers.'

scenes.camera: Top-down on phone, smooth UI macro
scenes.action: Owner runs a Vehicle Insight Full Check on his own reg KT68 WRX. Green ticks cascade: 'No outstanding finance ✓ · Mileage verified ✓ · Never written off ✓'. He taps Share.
scenes.audio: Satisfying tick sounds over light percussion (volume: medium)

scenes.action: Buyer couple scroll the report on their phone, visibly relax, nod to each other. Handshake over the keys. A 'SOLD IN 3 DAYS' stamp slams over the frame.

dialogue.speaker: buyer
dialogue.line: Honestly, the report answered everything. We'll take it.

scenes.action: Vehicle Insight logo, headline 'Sell faster. Back your price.', CTA 'Get your report →' with soft double-bounce, 4.8-star rating, partner wordmarks: The Telegraph, What Car?, Halfords, Select Car Leasing, Asda.
scenes.audio: Warm closing chord. VO, male, confident: "Prove it's clean. Sell it faster. Vehicle Insight."

style: Realistic UGC-adjacent energy with polished motion-graphics overlays, Fraunces + Inter Tight type, 1080x1920 vertical
